## 在 PowerShell 7 視窗裡直接貼(7.0 以上 · 例 7.6.9)

```powershell
& { $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'; $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; if ($PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) { Write-Host '[RED] 這一行要 PowerShell 7 以上(pwsh)' -ForegroundColor Red; return }; $R = $env:VRN2_ROOT ?? 'C:\Users\tonyk\OneDrive\Documents\movies-dataset\VeritasIntelligenceAnalytics'; $P = 'VeritasIntelligenceAnalytics/docs/handoff/ai/vrn2_release_v0153'; $F = 'VRN2_RoundAll_v0109.py'; $H = '716bfe2bd911710d4c3ce06271404b4466f004428a10044910dab379d2884e89'; $top = git -C $R rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null; if (-not $top) { Write-Host "[RED] $R 不是 git 倉或找不到 git(先設 `$env:VRN2_ROOT)" -ForegroundColor Red; return }; $t = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) "vrn2_roundall_$(Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd_HHmmss)"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $t | Out-Null; $z = Join-Path $t 'roundall.zip'; $src = $null; foreach ($b in 'claude/optimistic-goodall-yhalc5', 'main') { foreach ($w in 0, 2, 4, 8, 16) { if ($w) { Start-Sleep -Seconds $w }; git -C $top fetch -q origin $b 2>&1 | Out-Null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { break } }; git -C $top archive --format=zip -o $z "origin/${b}:$P" $F 2>&1 | Out-Null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $z)) { $src = $b; break } }; if (-not $src) { Write-Host "[RED] 讀不到 GitHub 分支或 main 的 $F(網路 / git)" -ForegroundColor Red; return }; Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $z -DestinationPath $t -Force; $code = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $t $F), [Text.Encoding]::UTF8) -replace "`r`n", "`n"; $bytes = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false).GetBytes($code); $sha = [Convert]::ToHexString([Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::HashData($bytes)).ToLowerInvariant(); if ($sha -ne $H) { Write-Host "[RED] $F SHA-256 不對($sha)· 不執行" -ForegroundColor Red; return }; $dst = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "Downloads\$F"; [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($dst, $bytes); $py = $env:VRN2_PY ?? (Get-Command python, py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Source -NotMatch 'WindowsApps' | Select-Object -First 1).Source; if (-not $py) { Write-Host '[RED] 找不到 python(不要用 WindowsApps 的假 python)' -ForegroundColor Red; return }; Write-Host "[GREEN] $F SHA-256 $($H.Substring(0, 12)) 相符(GitHub $src)→ $dst · 用 $py 執行" -ForegroundColor Green; & $py $dst --root $R @(($env:VRN2_ROUNDALL_ARGS ?? '') -split '\s+' | Where-Object { $_ }); Write-Host "[計] RoundAll 結束碼 $LASTEXITCODE(視窗不會關)" }
```

只重跑 ⑪ + 收尾頁:同一個視窗先貼 `$env:VRN2_ROUNDALL_ARGS = '--only package,verify,report,closeout,pasteback'` 再貼上面那一行;只重做報告:`'--only report,closeout,pasteback'`;用完 `Remove-Item Env:VRN2_ROUNDALL_ARGS`。

## cmd 可以貼的一行(PowerShell 7 · 內容 = 最下面的解開版)

```bat
pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -EncodedCommand 
```

沒有 PowerShell 7 時(Windows PowerShell 5.1 · 內容一樣):

```bat
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -EncodedCommand 
```

## 已經有這個檔時

```bat
python "%USERPROFILE%\Downloads\VRN2_RoundAll_v0109.py"
python "%USERPROFILE%\Downloads\VRN2_RoundAll_v0109.py" --only package,verify,report,closeout,pasteback
python "%USERPROFILE%\Downloads\VRN2_RoundAll_v0109.py" --only report,closeout,pasteback
```

第 2 行 = 只重跑 ⑪ 獨立驗證 + 收尾頁(約 10 分鐘)· 第 3 行 = 只重做報告 + 收尾頁(幾秒)。PowerShell 把 `%USERPROFILE%` 換成 `$env:USERPROFILE`。

## 一行解開來的程式碼(核對用 · cmd 那兩行解開都是這段)

```text
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'   # Expand-Archive 的進度條在 PS 5.1 很慢 · 輸出導向時 pwsh 會印 CLIXML
try { [Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8 } catch { }
$R  = if ($env:VRN2_ROOT) { $env:VRN2_ROOT } else { 'C:\Users\tonyk\OneDrive\Documents\movies-dataset\VeritasIntelligenceAnalytics' }
$Br = 'claude/optimistic-goodall-yhalc5'
$P  = 'VeritasIntelligenceAnalytics/docs/handoff/ai/vrn2_release_v0153'
$F  = 'VRN2_RoundAll_v0109.py'
$H  = '716bfe2bd911710d4c3ce06271404b4466f004428a10044910dab379d2884e89'
Write-Host ('[VRN-2] PowerShell ' + $PSVersionTable.PSVersion + ' · 從 GitHub 讀 VRN2_RoundAll_v0109.py(核對 SHA-256 後執行)') -ForegroundColor Yellow
$top = git -C $R rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null
if (-not $top) { Write-Host "[RED] $R 不是 git 倉或找不到 git(先設 `$env:VRN2_ROOT)" -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }
$top = "$top".Trim()
$t = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('vrn2_roundall_' + (Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'))
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $t | Out-Null
$z = Join-Path $t 'roundall.zip'; $okz = $false
foreach ($b in $Br, 'main') {
  foreach ($w in 0, 2, 4, 8, 16) { if ($w) { Start-Sleep -Seconds $w }; git -C $top fetch -q origin $b 2>&1 | Out-Null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { break } }
  git -C $top archive --format=zip -o $z ('origin/' + $b + ':' + $P) $F 2>&1 | Out-Null
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $z)) { $okz = $true; Write-Host ('[計] 來源 GitHub ' + $b) -ForegroundColor DarkGray; break }
}
if (-not $okz) { Write-Host "[RED] 讀不到 GitHub 分支 $Br 或 main 的 $F(網路 / git)" -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }
Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $z -DestinationPath $t -Force
$code = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $t $F), [Text.Encoding]::UTF8) -replace "`r`n", "`n"
$bytes = (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)).GetBytes($code)
$sha = -join ([Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create().ComputeHash($bytes) | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString('x2') })
if ($sha -ne $H) { Write-Host "[RED] $F SHA-256 不對($sha)· 不執行" -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }
$dst = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE ('Downloads\' + $F)
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($dst, $bytes)
$exe = if ($env:VRN2_PY) { $env:VRN2_PY } else { (Get-Command python, py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Source -notmatch 'WindowsApps' } | Select-Object -First 1).Source }
if (-not $exe) { Write-Host '[RED] 找不到 python(不要用 WindowsApps 的假 python)' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }
Write-Host ('[GREEN] ' + $F + ' SHA-256 ' + $H.Substring(0, 12) + ' 相符 → ' + $dst + ' · 用 ' + $exe + ' 執行') -ForegroundColor Green
$ra = @($dst, '--root', $R)
if ($env:VRN2_ROUNDALL_ARGS) { $ra += ($env:VRN2_ROUNDALL_ARGS -split '\s+' | Where-Object { $_ }) }
& $exe @ra
exit $LASTEXITCODE
```
